title: ATF Decision
description: The Decision Engine's output for a Transaction Intent (docs/PRD.md §10). Only decision_id, intent_id, decision, and reasons are required: that is the full shape atf-decision currently produces. risk_score, policy_version, required_approvals, obligations, and expires_at are part of the eventual PRD §10 shape but are not emitted by any crate in this repo yet (no Approval Engine, no Policy Bundle versioning) — see docs/architecture.md. additionalProperties is left open at the top level so those fields can be added later without breaking existing validators.

risk_score.description: Not yet produced by atf-decision; PRD §10 example only.

policy_version.description: Not yet produced; waits on Policy Bundle versioning (PRD §11.3).

required_approvals.description: Not yet produced; waits on atf-approval (Phase 4).

obligations.description: Not yet produced; waits on atf-approval/atf-reconciliation (Phase 4).

expires_at.description: Not yet produced; waits on the Approval Engine (Phase 4).
